remarks: West Hills corner lot home featuring 4 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, a primary suite, herringbone floors, and an in-ground pool. Highlights include smooth interior walls, sleek smooth stucco exterior, a 72" iron front door entryway, and a guest bathroom with a jetted tub. Equipped with paid-off solar panels, a high-efficiency tankless water heater/solar combo, and brand-new AC ducting. Main house renovations will be completed prior to closing. Plans are drawn for a detached garage ADU conversion with mid-renovation progress underway offering a great opportunity for an end-user or investor to complete the ADU and customize the outdoor space.
